body:
Phase 5 of docs/specs/pi-native-flush.md (READ IT FIRST — items 5.1–5.4). Builds on merged Phases 1–4 of plugins/adlc-pi. This ticket makes the package RELEASE-READY and lands the docs; the actual npm publish runs through the repo's existing lockstep /release flow (docs/RELEASING.md + .github/workflows/publish.yml) and is NOT executed by this ticket.

=== VERIFIED pi PACKAGING FACTS (0.80.3, from the pi package's docs/packages.md) ===
- Distribution: `pi install npm:@adlc/pi-package` (user-global, ~/.pi/agent/npm/...) or `pi install -l npm:@adlc/pi-package` (project-local .pi/, team-auto-installs on trusted startup). settings.json `packages` array is the persisted registration.
- Gallery: `"keywords": ["pi-package"]` lists the package on pi.dev/packages.
- The `pi` manifest field declares surfaces: currently `{ extensions, skills }` — prompts/ was added in Phase 3; ensure `pi.prompts` is declared (it is) and globs are correct.
- Install runs `npm install --omit=dev` in the package dir: runtime deps (@adlc/core, @adlc/rails-guard, @adlc/build-gate, @adlc/flail-detector, @adlc/gate-manifest) must be in `dependencies` (they are).
- CRITICAL packaging rule: the FIVE pi core packages (@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent, @earendil-works/pi-ai, pi-agent-core, pi-tui, typebox) must be peerDependencies with version "*" and never bundled. Current peerDependencies pins ">=0.79.0" — change to "*" per the convention (compatibility is documented in the README/docs instead). Keep the exact devDependency pin (0.80.3) for CI.

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. plugins/adlc-pi/package.json: remove `private: true`; add `keywords: ["pi-package", "adlc", ...]`, `license: "MIT"`, `repository` (git+https://github.com/voodootikigod/adlc.git, directory plugins/adlc-pi), `homepage`, `bugs`, `author` — mirror packages/core/package.json field conventions; peerDependency `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent: "*"`; add a `files` allowlist (index.ts, lib/, skills/, prompts/, README.md) so npm pack ships only the runtime surface (NOT test/). Add a plugins/adlc-pi/README.md (install, what you get, links).
2. Release flow: verify scripts/release.mjs already version-bumps plugins/* with package.json (it does — read the comment about adlc-pi stranded at 1.0.2) and that the publish workflow will pick the package up once un-private; if publish.yml enumerates packages explicitly, add plugins/adlc-pi; if it publishes all non-private workspaces, confirm plugins are included and document the finding in the PR body. Do NOT trigger a release.
3. Version-matrix smoke (spec 5.3): scripts/pi-version-matrix.mjs — runs the existing scripts/pi-live-deny.mjs against BOTH the pinned devDependency pi version and the latest published pi (installed into a temp prefix via `npm install --prefix <tmp> @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@latest`, overriding the pi binary path via an env var the live-deny script must learn to honor: ADLC_PI_BIN). Wire as a NON-required scheduled/optional CI job (new workflow docs/ci-style: .github/workflows/pi-version-matrix.yml on workflow_dispatch + weekly cron) so upstream drift is detected without flaking the required job. scripts/pi-live-deny.mjs gets the minimal ADLC_PI_BIN override (its pinned-binary default behavior unchanged — the required CI leg still uses the devDependency).
4. Docs truth v2 (spec 5.4): apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/pi.mdx — rewrite Install (one-command pi install story once published, with the from-checkout fallback until the first release ships), update 'What you get' + the Formal ADLC coverage table for Phases 2–4 (build-gate, flail, evidence rail, custom-tool coverage, command surface, widget, adlc_prosecute/adlc_gate tools, /adlc-accept, rollback), and replace the 'design intent, not shipped' paragraph with the real remaining gaps. docs/integrations/pi.md: update the Shipped-vs-design-intent ledger to match. README.md integrations line stays accurate. docs/package-reference.md (or the toolkit docs page that enumerates packages): add @adlc/pi-package if other plugin packages are listed there — mirror whatever the opencode/cursor packages do.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: `node -e "const j=require('./plugins/adlc-pi/package.json'); if (j.private) throw 1"` passes; keywords include 'pi-package'; peerDependencies['@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent'] === '*'; files allowlist excludes test/. `npm pack --dry-run` in plugins/adlc-pi lists index.ts, lib/, skills/, prompts/, README.md and NO test files. VERIFY: run both.
- AC2: `node scripts/release.mjs --help` or a dry-run inspection confirms plugins/adlc-pi participates in the lockstep version bump (read the script; cite the line). The publish pipeline finding (included or explicitly added) is documented in the commit body. VERIFY: quoted evidence.
- AC3: `ADLC_PI_BIN=$(pwd)/node_modules/.bin/pi node scripts/pi-live-deny.mjs` passes (override honored); plain `node scripts/pi-live-deny.mjs` still passes (default unchanged); scripts/pi-version-matrix.mjs exits 0 locally when latest == pinned or reports the drift clearly (exit 0 with a WARN line when latest passes, exit 1 only when latest FAILS the deny proof). The new workflow file exists and is cron+dispatch, not push-required. VERIFY: run all three.
- AC4: pi.mdx contains the pi install one-liner and no longer claims P5 subagent prosecution / scheduled P7 are unshipped-design-intent items that actually shipped; the coverage table names the Phase 2–4 surfaces. VERIFY: grep for the stale claims (absent) and new rows (present).
- AC5: full root `npm test` exits 0; `node scripts/pi-live-deny.mjs` and `node scripts/pi-live-prosecute.mjs` pass.

Suppressions denied; marker fixtures by concatenation. Sibling plugins and packages/** are frozen rails; .github/workflows/ci.yml is NOT in scope (the required job is untouched — the matrix job is a NEW workflow file).
title: pi Phase 5: make @adlc/pi-package npm-publishable, one-command install story, version-matrix smoke, docs truth v2
